about: SystemSculpt Obsidian plugin analytics catalog (T-4689). Obsidian's developer policies ban client-side telemetry, so the plugin sends no analytics events itself. Use is measured server-side: each plugin call to api.systemsculpt.com becomes a PostHog event (project 706615, site=systemsculpt.com) defined in the systemsculpt-website repo's analytics/events.json, tagged with the headers below. Public stats (Obsidian community downloads per version, GitHub stars and release downloads) arrive daily as plugin_public_stats_daily. src/core/plugin/__tests__/analytics-catalog.test.ts fails when a command has no entry here, an entry names no command, a command names an unknown event, or an event's endpoint is called nowhere.

studio-field-history.not_measured: Studio field edits, blur boundaries and undo/redo stay in the vault. No server call or client telemetry is sent.

vault-search-pagination.not_measured: Vault search and cursor paging run locally. Shortening an oversized preview or rejecting oversized response metadata sends no telemetry or server call.

studio-shape-resize-cancel.not_measured: Cancelling a local shape resize restores canvas geometry and releases pointer listeners without a server call or client telemetry.

audio-processor-run-lifetime.not_measured: Local run teardown and unload-safe resume admission send no telemetry. Existing audio_processing API events measure only requests that are actually sent.

chat-source-citation-open.not_measured: Opening a cited source note stays in the vault through Obsidian openLinkText. No server call or client telemetry is sent.

events.name: patreon_support_referral
events.description: Direct Patreon support links carry utm_campaign=patreon_everywhere and utm_source=plugin_settings, plugin_upgrade_modal, plugin_funding or plugin_readme. Patreon may use these campaign tags; plugin clicks are not measured and no client telemetry or redirect is sent. Patreon support does not activate SystemSculpt Pro.

events.name: plugin_public_stats_daily
events.description: Daily public stats, one event per Pacific day: Obsidian community downloads total and per version, GitHub stars, forks, watchers, open issues and release downloads per tag (deltas since the last run).

events.name: plugin_usage_daily
events.description: Daily SystemSculpt account use from the production database, counts only (no person, no consent-gated sampling): accounts active in the trailing 7 days by plan and mode, and hosted use returning from the prior 7 days. Active = license key used by the plugin or a hosted charge. Each property is <metric>_<plan>, plan in subscriber | lifetime | free | no_key | all. Open installs, signed in or not, come from the update check every running plugin already makes (startup and every 6 hours): distinct client IPs per day and week from Cloudflare request analytics, counts only, no new client call. An IP proxy, not people. Signed-in active counts include iPhone app use; iphone_captures_7d shows it.

properties.signups_7d_<plan>: accounts created in the last 7 days
properties.active_7d_<plan>: license key used or hosted charge in the last 7 days
properties.active_7d_older_30d_<plan>: active accounts created over 30 days ago
properties.no_hosted_7d_<plan>: active, no hosted charge: own provider, Claude Code/Codex or local features only
properties.own_ai_7d_<plan>: active, no hosted chat (chat, if any, on their own AI)
properties.audio_docs_7d_<plan>: hosted transcription, audio processing or documents
properties.hosted_returning_7d_<plan>: hosted in both the last 7 days and the 7 before
properties.iphone_captures_7d_<plan>: charged iPhone capture actions (format, ask, action) in the last 7 days
properties.update_check_installs_1d_<6x|5x>: distinct client IPs calling the update check in the last 24 hours
properties.update_check_calls_1d_<6x|5x>: update-check requests in the last 24 hours
properties.update_check_installs_7d_<6x|5x>: distinct client IPs calling the update check in the last 7 days
properties.update_check_installs_returning_7d_<6x|5: IPs seen in both the last 7 days and the 7 before
properties.update_check_max_sample_interval: Cloudflare adaptive sampling interval (1 = unsampled); counts are never extrapolated
